mapper.select: SELECT DATE(o.created_at) AS sales_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o WHERE AND o.created_at >= #{from} AND o.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at) ORDER BY sales_date

SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name AS category_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(i.subtotal) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE AND o.created_at >= #{from} AND o.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT i.product_id, i.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(i.subtotal) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE AND o.created_at >= #{from} AND o.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY i.product_id, i.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, i.product_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = #{status}
